transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
I've been losing a lot of weight lately, and I'm barely eating anything. I usually only manage to eat a few bites of food a day now.
Are you avoiding food because you’re afraid of gaining weight or because you feel your body is too large, even though others may say you’re thin?

Yes, I am absolutely terrified of gaining weight or getting fat. Even though people tell me I'm already too thin, I get so anxious if the scale goes up even a tiny bit. I just feel like I need to keep my weight as low as possible.
When you look at your body, do you still feel overweight or see yourself as larger than you really are?

Yes, definitely. When I look in the mirror, I still feel overweight and see so many areas where I need to lose weight. Even though people tell me I'm underweight, that's just not what I see when I look at myself.
Have you been doing anything to keep your weight down besides eating very little, like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising a lot?
No, I don't do any of those things like throwing up or using laxatives, and I don't really exercise either. I only try to control my weight by strictly limiting how much I eat.
About how much do you weigh now, and what is your height?

I would really prefer not to share my exact weight right now because I still feel so heavy and ashamed of the number. I am about average height, but even thinking about the scale makes me feel really anxious.
Have you had any physical changes from the weight loss, like feeling faint, being unusually cold, or if you have periods, have they become irregular or stopped?
I haven't really noticed any of those physical symptoms, or at least I'm not sure about them. I'm just so focused on worrying about my weight and trying to make sure I don't eat too much.
How long have you been eating this little and feeling this intense fear about gaining weight?
I'm not really sure exactly how long it has been going on. I haven't really kept track of the exact timeframe because I've just been so focused on trying to control what I eat.
Do you ever have times when you eat a large amount of food in a short period and feel like you can’t stop?
No, I never have episodes like that where I eat a lot or lose control. I actually do the complete opposite and make sure I eat almost nothing. I strictly control my intake so that never happens.
Has this fear of gaining weight and eating so little been affecting your daily life, like school, work, relationships, or your ability to concentrate?

I'm not really sure, and I haven't thought much about how it affects things like my relationships or concentration. I'm just constantly worried about my weight and focusing all my energy on keeping my intake as low as possible.
Before this started, was your weight higher than it is now, and have your clothes become much looser or others commented that you’ve lost a lot of weight?

Yes, my weight was definitely higher before and has been steadily dropping. My clothes have become extremely loose, and people around me keep commenting on how much weight I've lost. Despite what they say, I still feel like I need to lose more, and the thought of gaining any of it back is absolutely terrifying.
